rca of the issue: The frontend nearby-share-chat flow calls POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages with attachment payload {type:'location_share', share_type:'place', name, address, lat, lng, directions_url, ...}. The backend endpoint (routers/posts_feed.py create_message) coerces each attachment via `MessageAttachment(**a)`. MessageAttachment is a strict Pydantic model (default extra='ignore' from BaseModel) and only declares type/url/filename/size/duration/sticker_id/emoji/is_emoji/card_*/post_id/poster_url/caption/author_name/kind. All place-specific fields (share_type, name, address, lat, lng, directions_url) are silently dropped. On the GET side the stored attachment has nulls, and the FE LocationMessagePreview requires attachment.share_type==='place' to render — hence nothing renders. Mitigation: either add the fields to MessageAttachment or set model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow') on it.
